summary: MPLS and GMPLS networks can be built from layered networks, and efficient end-to-end paths need to span layers. This document extends PCEP so path computation requests and responses can handle multiple layers, including how to ask for a path that crosses them.

eli5.summary: Think of a trip that uses a highway and a ferry. The route planner has to plan across both kinds of travel, not just one.

questions: how does pcep support multi-layer paths
